table.name: TLGNR_MAP_EXTRA_DN_TYPE_BS
table.description: Storing contract type, sales area code and indicating whether these combinations need Export invoice, Cash sales or regular delivery note.

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SAREA. Sales Area for this order. The Sales Organisation (TLGNC_SAREA.sorg_cd) is a part of the sales area identifier, besides distribution channel and division.

column.name: PRINT_EXPORT_INVOICE
column.description: If this flag is true, an Export invoice needs to be printed too.

column.name: PRINT_CASH_SALES
column.description: If this flas is true, a Cash Sales invoice needs to be printed too.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
